description: List available ClickHouse tables in a database, including schema, comment, row count, and column count.

database.description: Name of the ClickHouse database whose tables to list.

like.description: Optional ClickHouse LIKE pattern to filter table names; only tables whose names match the pattern are returned.

not_like.description: Optional ClickHouse NOT LIKE pattern to filter table names; tables whose names match the pattern are excluded.

name: list_tables
